# Prioocare

> > Prioocare is Malaysia's pharmacy merchandising and pharmaceutical distribution expert, specializing in retail services, regulatory compliance, and supply chain solutions for the healthcare sector.

Prioocare provides comprehensive pharmacy distribution, merchandising services, and regulatory guidance across Malaysia. The platform offers resources on NPRA compliance, KKM regulations, GMP certification, and best practices for pharmaceutical wholesalers, retailers, and healthcare professionals navigating Malaysia's pharmaceutical landscape.

## Key Topics

- Pharmacy Distribution & Wholesale
- Pharmacy Merchandising Services
- NPRA (National Pharmaceutical Regulatory Agency)
- KKM Regulatory Compliance
- GMP & GDP Certification
- Malaysia Healthcare Sector
- Pharmaceutical Supply Chain
- Retail Pharmacy Operations
- Control of Drugs and Cosmetics Regulations 1984
- OTC Product Placement
- Pharmaceutical Distributors Licensing
- Visual Merchandising in Pharmacy
- Healthcare Logistics Malaysia
- Pharmacist Annual Certificate (APC)
- Southeast Asia Pharmaceutical Market
